🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “Ultimately, getting all three points is very good. I think we played with more intensity in the second half and scored three goals. That was a good thing.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “Yes, Pedri is fine. The plan was for him to play only 45 minutes, and regardless of what happened in the match, he would come off after that and Dani Olmo would come on. Olmo was also scheduled to play 45 minutes, no more. I think that was good, as it was for the other players, in terms of managing workloads and playing time”. #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick on players with less minutes:  “Of course, as I said before, it’s not easy. When you haven’t played many minutes in previous matches, it’s difficult to suddenly be involved in a match like this. But they performed well and did a good job. I’m happy with them, and that’s exactly what I want from them. #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Gavi: “Even if you’re getting fewer minutes, you still have to deliver. The season is long, the coach always says that, and players need to know their role”. #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick on Balde: “Balde suffered a minor sprain, which is why he had to leave the pitch. We’ll have to wait until tomorrow to find out more. In my view, his performance was excellent. It’s not easy for a player who doesn’t get much playing time to come straight into a game like this, but he did a good job.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick on Gabriel Jesus: “As you know, it’s not easy for Gabriel because he’s behind Raphinha in the pecking order. Raphinha always wants as many minutes as possible, and he’s a very important player for us. But Gabriel trains with great focus, and I really like his quality in training and his consistently positive attitude. When he came here, I told him I didn’t know how things would go and that he might sometimes get fewer minutes. He accepted that completely because he wants to HELP THE TEAM. Seeing his quality and the five goals he has scored in so few minutes is FANTASTIC. We still have seven more matches to go, and it’s very important to have players of this quality on the bench, ready to come on when we need them. That’s a good situation for us.” #fcblive
